summary: Examples show a URL matching a pattern that starts at the beginning and not matching a pattern that starts mid-string.
questions: Why does url is match('/users/.*') return false?
How do I match a URL prefix with a regex?

answer_card.title: match test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
url: "https://example.com/users/foo/resources/bar"
foundmatch: url is match("https://example.com/users/.*/resources")  # True
nomatch: url is match("/users/.*/resources")                       # False, not at start
```
